scientific_integrity: Exact all-prime-power proof; eight finite enumerations corroborate but do not replace proof. Source dated 2001 only to year, with earliest strictly day-resolved relevant public record verified on 2003-05-09.

title: Commutator-rank census of finite rectangular-band semigroup algebras
